spans.text: T1-weighted images were normalized and segmented into GM, white matter and CSF probability maps by using standard procedures and the fast-diffeomorphic image registration (DARTEL) algorithm [ 20 ]. GM segments were affine-transformed into the MNI (Montreal Neurological Institute) space, modulated and smoothed using a Gaussian kernel with 6-mm FWHM before analysis.
